title: DAY 8/90
BENDING STRESS
scenes.sub: From the beam diagram to the real stress
scenes.voice: Day eight of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge! One hundred and two days to GATE. Yesterday you drew the diagrams. Today you find the stresses they cause.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Today's subject is Strength of Materials. Our topic: bending and shear stresses in beams.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover the flexure formula, section modulus, T, I and flitched sections, and how shear stress is distributed across a beam section.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. Maximum shear stress is one and a half times the average for a rectangle, and four by three times for a circle, both at the neutral axis.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: Grab the free practice set with worked solutions on Telegram now. Tonight's test opens seven to nine P. M. in our one rupee challenge course.

scenes.title: Day 7 Toppers
scenes.voice: Day seven toppers! Rank one, Sweta Rani Sahoo, with a superb nineteen point six seven. Rank two, Marndi. Rank three, Akshay W. Congratulations to all three!
